WITH stable_recovery AS (
    SELECT ab.pat_owner_ref, asd.rec_status, asd.funcassess
    FROM assessmentbasics ab
    JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = ab.ab_key
    WHERE LOWER(asd.rec_status) = 'stable'
      AND LOWER(asd.funcassess->>'ADL_Func') IN ('Moderate Help', 'Dependent')
),
avg_missed AS (
    SELECT pat_ref, AVG(miss_appt) as avg_missed_appts
    FROM encounters
    GROUP BY pat_ref
),
sse_scores AS (
    SELECT ab.pat_owner_ref, ab.ab_key,
        CASE 
            WHEN asd.funcassess->>'Soc_Sup' = 'Strong' THEN 3
            WHEN asd.funcassess->>'Soc_Sup' = 'Adequate' THEN 2
            WHEN asd.funcassess->>'Soc_Sup' = 'Limited' THEN 1
            WHEN asd.funcassess->>'Soc_Sup' = 'Weak' THEN 0
            ELSE 0
        END +
        CASE 
            WHEN asd.funcassess->>'Rel_Qual' = 'Good' THEN 3
            WHEN asd.funcassess->>'Rel_Qual' = 'Fair' THEN 2
            WHEN asd.funcassess->>'Rel_Qual' = 'Poor' THEN 1
            WHEN asd.funcassess->>'Rel_Qual' = 'Conflicted' THEN 0
            ELSE 0
        END as sse_sum
    FROM assessmentbasics ab
    JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = ab.ab_key
),
latest_sse AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (pat_owner_ref) pat_owner_ref, sse_sum
    FROM sse_scores
    ORDER BY pat_owner_ref, ab_key DESC
)
SELECT 
    sr.pat_owner_ref as patient_id,
    COALESCE(am.avg_missed_appts, 0) as avg_missed_appointments,
    ls.sse_sum as latest_sse_score
FROM stable_recovery sr
LEFT JOIN avg_missed am ON am.pat_ref = sr.pat_owner_ref
LEFT JOIN latest_sse ls ON ls.pat_owner_ref = sr.pat_owner_ref
WHERE COALESCE(am.avg_missed_appts, 0) > 2 OR ls.sse_sum < 3;
